NONE: › a dead person who is believed, in some Caribbean religions, to have been brought back to life by magic
（加勒比地區某些宗教信仰中）靠巫術起死回生的僵屍，還魂屍
› informal disapproving a person who has no energy, seems to act without thinking, and does not notice what is happening
無生氣的人；木訥呆板的人

example: He's just a zombie sitting in front of the TV all day.
他就像個呆子一樣，一整天都坐在電視機前面。
